DirOpus Reimagined v0.1.30.0

A fast, cross-platform dual-panel file manager — inspired by the classic Amiga Directory Opus.

Hi! I've been building a file manager and just released a new version — thought you might like to try it. It runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux (Intel & ARM), it's free and open source, and there's nothing to install — just unzip and run.

The two-panel main window (Solarized Light theme).

What it does

  • Two folders side by side — copy, move, and compare between them, with folder tabs on each side.
  • All the file basics — copy / move / rename / delete, drag-and-drop, delete-to-Trash (recoverable), and undo for renames and moves.
  • Compare & sync two folders with a click.
  • Cloud storage built in — Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Amazon S3, and 50+ more, browsed like local folders.
  • Archives like folders — open .zip, .7z, .rar, and .tar, and now copy files into, rename and delete inside .zip and .tar archives.
  • Batch rename — rename a whole selection with a live before→after preview, find & replace (regex), and numbering.
  • Make it yours — banks of 36 custom buttons to launch your own tools, plus bookmarks and a built-in file viewer.
  • Themes — Light/Dark, Dracula, Nord, and Solarized.
  • Fast to drive — search by name or by what's inside files, recent folders, type-ahead jumping, and full keyboard control.
New in 0.1.28 to 0.1.30:
  • Write into archives — copy or move files into .zip, .tar and .tar.gz archives, and rename, delete and make folders inside them. The original is only replaced once the new one is complete.
  • Search inside files — the Find button looks for text inside files as well as names, with live results.
  • Undo — Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes the last rename or move.
  • Banks of buttons — as many sets of the 36 custom buttons as you like, switched with tabs, the mouse wheel or Alt+PageUp/PageDown. A label too long for its button shows in full when you hover over it.
  • Checksums — compute, compare, save and verify MD5 / SHA-1 / SHA-256 / SHA-512.
  • Also new: a recent-folders list (Alt+Down), choose which columns to show, symbolic-link support, pause and retry in the operation queue, and panels that refresh by themselves when files change.
Fixed: since 0.1.19, copying or moving to and from cloud folders, and copying or moving files out of archives, didn't work. 0.1.28 fixed that, and 0.1.29 fixes a stray line left around the active panel after resizing the window, and button labels cut off in small windows.
